rows.name: Sunderland
rows.character: 1. Two fixed lights 2. One fixed br. Tide lt.
rows.description: 1. Upper bright, lower red, in a white tower, 64 ft. high, on North pier-head 2. On South pier, from ½-flood till 2h. after H.W., and during the last 2h. a bright light is shown beneath it; a green light below it shows danger

rows.name: SOUTER POINT
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min. lower fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 76 ft. high. ELECTRIC light. Low light from S. by E. to S. ¾ W.; thence red to S. by W. ¾ W. over Whitburn Stile, Hendon Rocks, &c.

rows.name: TYNEMOUTH
rows.character: One rev. red lt., 1 min.
rows.description: White tower, 79 ft. high, near Priory ruins, in the castle. Light visible seaward between N. by E. ½ E. and S.W. ½ S.

rows.name: Tyne North Pier
rows.character: Bright, green, & red lts.
rows.description: Vertical, on North Pier Works. A red light at middle of North pier

rows.name: Tyne South Pier
rows.character: One occulting bright or red light, 10 secs.
rows.description: Groyne on Herd Sand. Lt. bright over N. pier and entr. betw. N.E. by E. ¾ E. and E. ½ S.; thence red to S.E. by E. ¾ E., over S. pier

rows.name: Tyne River
rows.character: Two fixed bright lts.
rows.description: At North Shields. White towers, 49 and 76 ft. high; in one, W. ¾ N., 240 yards apart

rows.name: Blyth
rows.character: 1. Two fix. br. Tide lts. 2. Two fixed lights
rows.description: 1. At South end of town, while 8 ft. water on bar; in one, N. by W. ¾ W. A blue flag by day 2. Upper red, lower bright, on S.W. end of extension of East pier

rows.name: Newbiggin
rows.description: Fixed lt., red seaward, during herring season

rows.name: COQUET ISLAND
rows.character: Two fixed bright or red lights in one tower
rows.description: White tower, 72 ft. high, on S.W. part. Upper light bright seaward between S. ½ W. and N. by E. ½ E.; thence red to N. by E., over Bulmer Bush Rocks, &c. Lower light bright from S.E. by S. ¾ S. to S. by E.; thence westward is red over Bondicar Bush, to S. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: Warkworth
rows.character: One fix. br. cr red Tide lt.
rows.description: On S. pier, while 10 ft. water on the bar. Shows bright S. of E. by S. ½ S., and red northward

rows.name: North Sunderland
rows.character: Two fix. lts., red and br.
rows.description: Leading lights on pier, from ½-flood to ¾-ebb. In line, bear S.W. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: FARN ISLAND
rows.character: Upper flashing light ev. 20 secs. Lower fixed bright light
rows.description: Two white towers, 43 and 27 ft. high; in one, N. by W. ½ W., 187 yds. apart. High light, near S.W. point, shows two bright flashes and one red flash: a flash every 20 secs. Low light, near N.W. point, visible between N.W. by N. ½ N. and N. by W.

rows.name: LONGSTONE
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: Red tower, 85 ft. high, on West side of rock. Dangers extend over ¾ of a mile to N.E.

rows.name: Berwick-on-Tweed
rows.character: Two fix. lts., br. and red
rows.description: In one tower, 44 ft. high, on pier-head. Upper light bright. Lts. not visible W. of Seal Carr Ledges. Low red lt. only while 10 ft. on bar

rows.name: Burnmouth
rows.character: Fixed lights
rows.description: Bright fishing light on pier, when safe, and red and bright leading lights

rows.name: Eyemouth
rows.description: Leading lights, upper red and lower bright

rows.name: ST. ABB'S HEAD
rows.character: One flash. br. lt., 10 s.
rows.description: White tower, 29 ft. high. A flash ev. 10 secs.

rows.name: Coldingham
rows.description: Red and green lights occasionally on piers

rows.name: Dunbar
rows.character: Two fixed lights
rows.description: Old Harbour lt. bright toward entrance; green to W.; red to E. Red lt. at Victoria Harbour. Additional lights in fishing season

rows.name: North Berwick
rows.description: Fish. lt. on N. pier, red seawd. On dark nights

rows.name: FIDRA ISLAND
rows.character: One 2-flash. br. lt., 15 s.
rows.description: Lighthouse, 56 feet high, near summit of island. Lt. shows two quick flashes

rows.name: Port Seton
rows.description: Fish. lt. on E. pier, red seawd. On dark nights

rows.name: Cockenzie
rows.description: A fixed bright light on East pier-head

rows.name: Morrison Haven
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: In winter, on W. pier-head. Bright between N.W. and S.E.; red between N.W. and S.W.

rows.name: INCHKEITH
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., 1 min.
rows.description: White tower, 58 ft. high, on summit of island

rows.name: Oxcar Rocks
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: Tower, 78 ft. high. Lt. shows br. to westwd. betw. W. ½ N. & W. by N. ¾ N., & to eastwd. betw. N.E. ½ E. & S.E. by S.; red elsewhere
